say:1:1210916001:1.text: Sinbad... Please tell me we won't run into any more wild beasts.
say:1:1210916001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达……前面还、还会有冲来冲去的野兽吗？

say:3:1210916002:1.text: It's hard to say. But come on, we'll get through this together!
say:3:1210916002:1.source_cn: 不好说啊，我倒是希望它们能换点花样。

say:5:1210916004:1.text: Stay strong, Hammie! We're definitely getting closer to the treasure now!
say:5:1210916004:1.source_cn: 打起精神，至少我们离宝藏越来越近了！

say:7:1210916005:1.text: Sinbad, you seem to know a lot about adventures and treasure hunting.
say:7:1210916005:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你好像对冒险和寻宝很有经验。

say:8:1210916006:1.text: It would've been dangerous if we hadn't had you back there.
say:8:1210916006:1.source_cn: 刚才如果没有你，一定很危险。

say:9:1210916007:1.text: This is nothing! My old man used to adventure everywhere. I've learned all sorts of stuff from his mishaps.
say:9:1210916007:1.source_cn: 这不算什么，我那个当船长的老爹，去过各种地方冒险，这些...

say:10:1210916008:1.text: When my hands were too small to even hold a compass, he'd tell me tales of his adventures. With so many stories, it's hard not to remember them all.
say:10:1210916008:1.source_cn: 在我的手掌小得还握不住罗盘的时候，他就开始给我讲各种各...

say:11:1210916009:1.text: I dreamed of becoming a captain like him, sailing ships across the seas! But... well, life had other plans.
say:11:1210916009:1.source_cn: 我小时候啊，还梦想像他一样，长大了做个船长，驾着船四处...

say:12:1210916010:1.text: But what? Why didn't you follow in your dad's footsteps?
say:12:1210916010:1.source_cn: 可惜什么？辛巴达为什么没有成为船长，出海冒险呢？

say:13:1210916011:1.text: Well... *Sigh* You've been to Brineville, yeah? You can guess why.
say:13:1210916011:1.source_cn: 我……唉，你们也去过小水村了，即使我不说，也猜得到吧？

choice_prompt:14:1210916011.text: Well... *Sigh* You've been to Brineville, yeah? You can guess why.
choice_prompt:14:1210916011.source_cn: 我……唉，你们也去过小水村了，即使我不说，也猜得到吧？

say:15:1210916012:1.text: If only he hadn't left with all the other men... My old man left me with quite a mess to clean up, didn't he? Maybe one day, I'll see him again...
say:15:1210916012:1.source_cn: 对啊，我老爹扔下的烂摊子，我得给他打理好吧？也许哪天再...
say:15:1210916012:1.male: If only he hadn't left with all the other men... My old man left me with quite a mess to clean up, didn't he? Maybe one day, I'll see him again...
say:15:1210916012:1.female: If only he hadn't left with all the other men... My old man left me with quite a mess to clean up, didn't he? Maybe one day, I'll see him again...

say:16:1210916013:1.text: In adventure stories, there's always an underdog that rises above all his misfortune. Perhaps he'll...
say:16:1210916013:1.source_cn: 冒险故事里总有人能绝处逢生，说不定他也……
say:16:1210916013:1.male: In adventure stories, there's always an underdog that rises above all his misfortune. Perhaps he'll...
say:16:1210916013:1.female: In adventure stories, there's always an underdog that rises above all his misfortune. Perhaps he'll...

say:17:1210916014:1.text: Ah, I know I'm daydreaming! But it doesn't hurt to dream once in a while.
say:17:1210916014:1.source_cn: 我知道是白日梦！但偶尔做做也不坏。
say:17:1210916014:1.male: Ah, I know I'm daydreaming! But it doesn't hurt to dream once in a while.
say:17:1210916014:1.female: Ah, I know I'm daydreaming! But it doesn't hurt to dream once in a while.

say:18:1210916016:1.text: That's so sad... Whenever Sinbad talks about adventure and treasure hunting, his eyes just light up!
say:18:1210916016:1.source_cn: 太可惜了，明明……辛巴达说起冒险和寻宝的时候，眼睛都在...

say:19:1210916017:1.text: You know, I've actually been to sea before. Before Rustport got sealed off, I'd sail out sometimes just to get some fresh air. I still remember how bright the stars were back then.
say:19:1210916017:1.source_cn: 其实，我也不是没有出过海，锈锚港被封锁之前，我也偶尔会...

say:20:1210916018:1.text: Afterward, I tried to navigate through the mist, but that eerie mist seemed to play games with me. No matter which way I went, I couldn't find a way out. I almost died at sea that time.
say:20:1210916018:1.source_cn: 锈锚港被封锁之后，我也试着穿越迷雾，但是……那诡异的雾...

say:22:1210916020:1.text: Let's not dwell on the past. The trials are waiting for us!
say:22:1210916020:1.source_cn: 以前的事就不提了，还有试炼在等着我们呢！

say:23:1210916021:1.text: My mothers will worry for me if I don't get off this island. I can't let them down. Let's go!
say:23:1210916021:1.source_cn: 要是没法离开小岛，我的母亲们就该替我担心了，我可不能让...

say:25:1210916015:1.text: Yeah... I can't help but worry about the folks back in the village. They've always been there for me. So that's where I gotta stay, for now.
say:25:1210916015:1.source_cn: 嗯……实在放心不下村里那些人，一直是她们在照顾我。所以...
say:25:1210916015:1.male: Yeah... I can't help but worry about the folks back in the village. They've always been there for me. So that's where I gotta stay, for now.
say:25:1210916015:1.female: Yeah... I can't help but worry about the folks back in the village. They've always been there for me. So that's where I gotta stay, for now.
